expectations.skip: silently skipped before decoding (not a decode error); the receiver keeps receiving
expectations.decode-error: counted as a decode error; no frame is dispatched; the receiver keeps receiving
expectations.accept: decoded and applied; see the description for how unknown parts read
expectations.ignore-page: decoded, but the page is not merged into the descriptor tables
expectations.drop-value: decoded; the value is not applied to the channel
expectations.fault: decoded; a receiver driving hardware does not follow it

vectors.description: Another protocol's datagram on the shared group: magic is not OMT1
Frame type 0x07, not defined by this schema
motion-pose cut short: the segment ends past the datagram
motion-pose whose segment table claims 64 more words than the datagram holds
motion-pose content in a multi-segment message (valid, never sent by canonical senders): reads like motion-pose
Discovery with gameName, typeLabel and location as null pointers: read as ""
motion-bodydynamics with dynamics discriminant 9: treat as noDynamics, keep pose
motion-drivepoints with drive point 1 (id 1) discriminant 99: ignore its state, keep the others
motion-wheel with the rpm optionality union's discriminant 5: treat as noRpm, keep the other fields
discovery-paged-p1 with page 2 of pageCount 2: malformed page, ignored
After discovery-channels: boolean channel id 2 sent as a number: drop the value
After discovery-channels: channel id 99, which nothing declares: never applied
motion-pose with position x NaN and y +inf: decodes; receivers driving hardware treat it as a fault (implementation-udp.md § Trust and safety)
